_why: The single list of libraries an artifact document loads, in order.
Six places assemble that document and they had already drifted: pdf.min.js
was loaded by the in-app renderer and by no other, so a dashboard embedding
a PDF rendered in the app and showed BowPdfViewer's 'nolib' state in the
thumbnail, the PDF export and the planner's preview. None of it errored.
Runtime readers: frontend/utils/artifactIframe.ts (imported at build) and
backend/app/services/artifact_libs.py (read from disk). The two static
shells (artifact-sandbox.html, mcp-artifact-app.html) cannot read a file,
so they are held in step by tests/unit/fork/test_every_artifact_renderer_agrees.py
instead. React is listed by family: each renderer picks development or
production, which is a build choice, not a different library.
